decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - External brickwork, bonding, mortar and pointing shall conform to that recommended in "Technical Note 1" of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
Condition : 4 - New tiles and leadwork shall conform to that recommended in "Technical Note 4" of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 5 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced a scheme showing details of the new and reinstated fireplaces shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be completed in acccordance with the approved details.
description: Removal of tiled roof surfaces and lead flashings & valleys secondary glazing to front windows, removal of partition & door to staircase & partition to first floor bathroom, adjustment of partition to ground floor WC , new opening and doors to dining room, and single storey rear extension, removal of fire place to ground floor and adjustment to opening
